SELECT s.stock_code, s.stock_name, s.market, sp.base_date, sp.open_price, sp.close_price, sp.low_price, sp.high_price, sp.change_amount, sp.volume, sp.trading_value, sp.market_cap FROM stock_price as sp JOIN stock_info as s on sp.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE sp.stock_code IN
#{code}
AND sp.base_date = #{baseDate}
ORDER BY sp.volume DESC
ORDER BY sp.open_price DESC
ORDER BY sp.close_price DESC
ORDER BY s.stock_name DESC
ORDER BY sp.stock_code ASC

INSERT INTO stock_price ( stock_code, base_date, open_price, change_amount, low_price, high_price, price_change, volume, trading_value, market_cap ) VALUES
( #{p.stockCode}, #{p.baseDate}, #{p.openPrice}, #{p.closePrice}, #{p.lowPrice}, #{p.highPrice}, #{p.changeAmount}, #{p.volume}, #{p.tradingValue}, #{p.marketCap} ) AS new_val ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open_price = new_val.open_price, high_price = new_val.high_price, low_price = new_val.low_price, close_price = new_val.close_price, change_amount = new_val.change_amount, volume = new_val.volume, trading_value = new_val.trading_value, market_cap = new_val.market_cap
